implementation_binding_note: The levels, repetitions, metrics, sizing and broker rules were frozen before the runner existed. This source hash was added after a discarded exploratory validation and before the create-only formal pilot.
queue: PostgreSQL JobRepository claim/lease; no broker or control-plane Redis
cleanup: Each repetition uses a new Incident, workflow and Job identity set and verifies all prior Jobs are terminal before the next level.

confirmatory_sizing.method: Use the largest per-level pilot standard deviation of log throughput and n=ceil((1.96*s/log(1.10))^2).

broker_threshold.rule: PostgreSQL is a measured bottleneck only if the median 8-worker throughput is at most 1.05 times the 4-worker median while 8-worker queue-wait P95 is at least 1.25 times the 4-worker value.
broker_threshold.correctness_gate: Any error, duplicate ownership or nonterminal Job fails the experiment but does not by itself justify a broker.

reporting: Publish every repetition, per-level distributions, the 1-worker baseline, absolute/relative deltas and 95% intervals. Local process CPU and Python heap exclude database/container resources.
